page.overview:
Who is Tarna Feir?

Tarna is from Altara and has pale, yellow hair, sharp, blue eyes, and a prominent chin. She is said to be humorless, arrogant, and haughty.

Tarna is of high average strength in the One Power, with a strength level of . She matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a gateway of useful size and is trusted enough by Elaida to be among the first sisters taught the weave.

She was born in the year 950 NE in the north of Altara near the Andoran border. She was a Wilder who touched saidar about as early as is possible for a girl to do so, but had developed a block that made her unable to touch the Source unless she had her eyes closed.

In , at the age of fourteen, she became a novice in the White Tower. Galina Casban helped her overcome that by beating her until she overcame her block. This was technically illegal, but the Mistress of Novices at the time kept silent about it. At this time, this would likely have been Merean Redhill. Both Merean and Galina were fairly highly ranking sisters of the Black Ajah. After spending nine years as novice and six as Accepted, Tarna was raised to the shawl in the year 979 NE.
